scripts.predev: powershell -Command "try { (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique) | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } catch {}; exit 0"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm.cmd --prefix backend run dev" "npm.cmd --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.clean: powershell -Command "try { (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique) | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } catch {}; exit 0"
